correctness.rationale: Uniform seven-adic falling-factorial interpolation is valid by valuation bounds for every term and derivative. F(0)=1 and F'(0)=-sum_{j>=0}j! = 1 (mod 7). The functional recurrence produces the exact seven-entry value row (1,0,1,5,2,5,6) and derivative row (1,5,4,1,5,1,3), all units. Difference quotients on each residue disc preserve seven-adic distances, and Hensel digit lifting gives full bijections onto the corresponding output discs. The parity split produces the frequency vector (2,3,3,0,0,3,3) for every 7^k, with correct index period, support and measure. The independent script passed 19,665 exact finite assertions over k<=5; all-level conclusions follow from the proof. No infinite computation is claimed.

originality.rationale: The evaluated seven-adic complete frequency vector (2,3,3,0,0,3,3), five-ball range and first missing-prime-level boundary are not stated or implied by the inspected prior work. Miska proves general derangement periods and p-adic interpolation, O'Desky–Richman supply broad analytic foundations, and the closest indexed complete fibers concern primes 2, 3 and 5. Those results do not compute the seven local derivative/value table. The prime-five calculation uses the same broad lifting method and is a real methodological overlap, not an implication of this different evaluated classification. Unindexed historical work remains a residual priority risk.

value.rationale: Seven is the first prime for which the classical derangement sequence misses residue classes modulo the prime itself, whereas primes 2,3,5 are surjective at that base level and prime five remains surjective at all powers. The entire seven-adic image, natural index densities and exact fiber multiplicities at every level form a complete natural classification of the first failure, rather than a chosen unmotivated finite slice. The five-ball boundary and two permanently forbidden balls are structurally meaningful and were not consequences of the compared general interpolation, period or smaller-prime image statements. No claim of a paper-scale general theorem or downstream consequence is necessary.
